formalCitations.exactSourceText:
**Modern-shape mnemonic, not etymology:** imagine the spreading top as a
roof over shelves, with the lower [口](口.md)-shaped box as a doorway.
This is an invented scene using the present outline, not a historical
component analysis or a claim that 口 supplies the meaning or sound.
The indexing radical is [人](人.md), not the separate building radical 宀.
出典『角川新字源 改訂新版』（ＫＡＤＯＫＡＷＡ）

[字形] 象形
穀物などをおさめる廩倉の形。〔説文〕五下に「[image without alt text]の[image without alt text](くら)なり。倉[image without alt text]として取りて之れを[image without alt text](おさ)む。故に之れを倉と謂ふ」とあり、倉黄・倉卒の意を以て解するが、倉は[image without alt text]（蔵）とその声が近い。また字形について「[image without alt text]の省に從ふ。口は倉の形に象る」とするが、[image without alt text]（食）は[image without alt text]（食器）の形に従うもので、倉とは関係がない。また、いま字を[image without alt text](しゆう)部に属するが、理由のないことである。字は器上に梱包した穀物をおき、これを覆蓋(ふがい)する形。のち高床の建物となった。〔説文〕に[image without alt text]字未収。〔周礼、考工記、匠人、注〕に「[image without alt text]は圜倉(ゑんさう)なり」とあり、倉を方形の穀倉と解するものであろう。

- The character dictionary Jitsu also records storing and a prison sense.
  Its quoted old-dictionary readings include ほろぶ and もろし.
  These are source-specific historical lookup information, not ordinary
  replacement readings for 倉庫; they are not added to practice metadata.
  [亡](亡.md), with a perishing branch, is conservatively separated from
  the old ほろぶ lookup. This is not a claim that everyday 倉 means
  "deceased." The modern-shape mnemonic does not explain these senses.
〔和名抄〕倉　久良（くら）／[image without alt text]倉　阿世久良（あぜくら）〔名義抄〕倉　クラ・ホロブ・モロシ／秀倉　ホクラ

comparisons.reason: 倉's treasury sense (JMdict 1592380, KANJIDIC) against treasure
comparisons.disposition: Harmless. 宝 is the valued thing itself (repo/kanji/宝.md:18), while 倉's treasury is the place where valuables are stored (snapshot/kanji/倉.md:25-27). Neither title fits the other card's meaning. No direct exclusion is declared on either card.

comparisons.reason: stored wealth and the treasury sense
comparisons.disposition: Harmless. 財 is the assets themselves, "not their container" (repo/kanji/財.md:18-19); 倉 is a building. No direct exclusion is declared on either card.

comparisons.reason: English "store" can mean a shop or a storehouse
comparisons.disposition: Harmless. The title is just "shop"; 店 is a place where goods are put out for sale (repo/kanji/店.md:19-21). No opened source gives 倉 a retail-shop sense; Daijisen's くら sense 3 is a historical pawnbroker (evidence/external-snapshots/03-extract.txt:16). No direct exclusion is declared on either card.
Harmless. 屋 covers roofs, shops and buildings in words (repo/kanji/屋.md:19) but has no storage sense. "Roof, shop" is not a defensible gloss for 倉. No direct exclusion is declared on either card.
Harmless. 館 names halls such as libraries, cinemas and inns (repo/kanji/館.md:19), not storage. No direct exclusion is declared on either card.

Harmless. 穀 names the crop category (repo/kanji/穀.md:20-23), while 倉 names the building that stores grain (evidence/external-snapshots/02-extract.txt:13). Grain and granary are distinct referents. Neither card declares an exclusion; 穀's own exclusions cover particular grains only (repo/kanji/穀.md:15).
Harmless. 米 is rice as grain and the US in 米国 (repo/kanji/米.md:19-20), with no storage sense. No direct exclusion is declared on either card.
Harmless. 預 means entrusting something to someone's care or custody (repo/kanji/預.md:19); 倉 is the storage building, not the act of entrusting. No direct exclusion is declared on either card.
Harmless. 保 means protecting or keeping something in a state (repo/kanji/保.md:20), with no building sense. No direct exclusion is declared on either card.

Harmless. The card teaches only surrounding and enclosure senses (repo/kanji/囲.md:19). KANJIDIC's store/keep glosses for 囲 (evidence/kanjidic2-records.xml:1218-1222) are verbs, not a storehouse noun, and 倉's title is not "enclose". No direct exclusion is declared on either card.

Harmless. 容 means containing and appearance (repo/kanji/容.md:19-21); the card itself separates a container from its contents. Neither half of the title fits 倉. No direct exclusion is declared on either card.
Harmless. 積 means stacking, loading and accumulating (repo/kanji/積.md:19-21), with no place-of-storage sense. No direct exclusion is declared on either card.
Harmless. 備 means having what is needed or getting ready (repo/kanji/備.md:19-21). The card mentions "supplies" only as a labelled mnemonic. No direct exclusion is declared on either card.
Harmless. 荷 is the load or baggage itself (repo/kanji/荷.md:19), not where it is kept. No direct exclusion is declared on either card.

comparisons.reason: stored goods and the treasure reading たから
comparisons.disposition: Harmless. 貨 means goods, freight, property or currency, and たから means treasure (repo/kanji/貨.md:19, repo/kanji/貨.md:30). None of these is a storehouse. No direct exclusion is declared on either card.

comparisons.reason: room or storeroom against 倉's cellar sense
comparisons.disposition: Harmless. 房's opened senses are side rooms, dwellings, bedrooms, partitioned spaces and tassels (repo/kanji/房.md:19-21), with no storehouse or cellar sense. 房 excludes 室 for "room" (repo/kanji/房.md:15), but exclusions are not transitive and do not cover 倉. No direct exclusion is declared on either card.

Harmless. 箱 is a box or case (repo/kanji/箱.md:19-21), not a building. 箱 shares the on'yomi ソウ (repo/kanji/箱.md:9), but that affects readings only; the supplied reading audit reports 0 hits for this pool. No direct exclusion is declared on either card.

comparisons.reason: the busy gloss in 倉卒 and the hurried branch
comparisons.disposition: Harmless. "Busy" is a gloss of the whole word 倉卒 (JMdict 1399200). 倉's own secondary sense is "flustered; sudden" (あわてる・にわか) in Kanjipedia (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:23) and Jitsu (evidence/external-snapshots/02-extract.txt:49), not having much to do (repo/kanji/忙.md:19-20). No direct exclusion is declared on either card.

Harmless. 速 is speed of motion (repo/kanji/速.md:19). 倉's branch is flustered haste or suddenness (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:23), not speed. No direct exclusion is declared on either card.

comparisons.reason: both have a sudden (にわか) secondary sense
comparisons.disposition: Harmless. Both have a source-only にわか lookup sense (repo/kanji/卒.md:43; evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:21), but neither displayed title expresses suddenness: "graduate; finish" does not fit 倉, and "granary; storehouse" does not fit 卒. No direct exclusion is declared on either card.

Harmless. ほろぶ is only an old-dictionary quoted reading for 倉 (evidence/external-snapshots/02-extract.txt:51), not an ordinary meaning. 倒 means losing an upright position (repo/kanji/倒.md:19-21). No direct exclusion is declared on either card.

Harmless. もろし is likewise only an old-dictionary quotation (evidence/external-snapshots/02-extract.txt:51), and the 倉 card says such quotations are not ordinary readings (snapshot/kanji/倉.md:77-80). 弱 is weakness (repo/kanji/弱.md:19). No direct exclusion is declared on either card.

comparisons.reason: The required storehouse pair; also checks any existing mention of 倉
comparisons.disposition: Collision needing exclusion, already handled. 庫's title "storehouse" is a defensible meaning of 倉, and both are written くら in JMdict 1592380 (repo/kanji/庫.md:3, repo/kanji/庫.md:19). The exclusion is declared on 倉 (snapshot/kanji/倉.md:14), not on 庫, which is sufficient because a declaration on either card excludes the pair. 庫 already links 倉庫.

comparisons.reason: The required storehouse pair; also checks any existing mention of 倉
comparisons.disposition: Collision needing exclusion, already handled. The storehouse sense is identical (repo/kanji/蔵.md:3, repo/kanji/蔵.md:19). The exclusion is declared on 倉 (snapshot/kanji/倉.md:14), not on 蔵. 蔵 mentions 倉 in plain text (repo/kanji/蔵.md:47); backlinks are not required.

acceptanceLimit: Mechanics and factual source bindings only; no linguistic verdict is inferred.
